name: Meta (Facebook, Instagram)
label: your app, but make it a legal entity
summary: Dev mode works instantly for you and your testers. Letting the public use anything real means business verification, App Review, and then a yearly check-up.
blocker: Advanced access needs a verified business first. Without it your approved permissions only work for people with a role on the app.

steps.title: Create the app and stay in Development mode
steps.detail: New non-business apps start in Development mode. Business-type apps have no modes and use access levels instead. Stay in development until testing is done.

steps.title: Build against people with a role
steps.detail: In Development mode any permission can be granted, but only to people with a role (developer, tester) and to test users. Test users can't interact with real ones.

steps.title: Make the required test API calls
steps.detail: Review requires test calls made within the 30 days before you submit. They can take up to 24 hours to appear on the Testing page, so don't leave this to submission day.

steps.title: Verify your business
steps.detail: Advanced access, for any permission, requires a verified business linked to the app. Individual verification no longer counts once business verification is available.

steps.title: Submit for App Review
steps.detail: Read the developer policies, meet security and privacy requirements, list the permissions you need, submit. If rejected there is a live chat for rejected apps. No review timeline is stated.

steps.title: Implement a data deletion callback
steps.detail: Needed before going live when you've implemented a use case.

steps.title: After approval: Data Use Checkup, every year
steps.detail: A yearly certification that permissions are used within the platform terms. Advanced permissions also need a Data Protection Assessment.

blockers.symptom: Works for you, fails for real users
blockers.cause: The app is in Development mode, or the permission isn't approved.
blockers.fix: Finish review for the specific permissions, then switch to Live.

blockers.cause: The app isn't linked to a verified or pending business.
blockers.fix: Link the app to a verified business in Business settings.

blockers.cause: No successful API calls in the last 30 days, or they haven't shown up yet.
blockers.fix: Make the calls, wait up to 24 hours, then submit.

blockers.cause: Review found the use case or the demonstration insufficient.
blockers.fix: Use the live chat offered for rejected apps, then resubmit.

agent: Build and exercise every permission against test users

you: Start business verification first, it is the long pole
Submit App Review under your own login
Do the Data Use Checkup every year

redirect.rule: Set valid OAuth redirect URIs in the Facebook Login settings. The pages we read don't state matching rules.
